entries.name: textarea
entries.purpose: The free-text "in your own words" voice-note textarea (inside the fine-tune reveal) that overrides the preset personality.
entries.promise: Revealed with #adv-body; accepts free text that onWake() folds into the agent's voice spec, overriding the archetype where they conflict.
entries.notes: Live-proven cold boot — hidden until adv-toggle opens, then visible + accepts typed text (app.js reads it at 1475). KNOWN: no test/journey guards the textarea → voice-spec seam. Evidence cold.json#probes.advToggle.typed.

entries.name: Voice mode: off (push-to-talk), click for hands-free
entries.purpose: Voice-mode toggle — switch between push-to-talk (default each session) and a hands-free conversation loop.
entries.promise: aria-pressed + title truthfully reflect convoMode (OFF/push-to-talk at rest: pressed=false, "voice mode: OFF (push-to-talk) — click for hands-free conversation"); a click flips it and reflectMode updates the button; hidden entirely when STT is unavailable.
entries.notes: AUDITED not perfected: rest-state live-proven (aria-pressed=false, title push-to-talk, no .on — .uiatlas/world2-evidence/comms-composer-probe.txt, voice-mode), but no test/journey clicks it or asserts reflectMode flips the press-state / STT-gated hide. Coverage gap filed (fp c3fa1f39 → voice lane).

entries.name: archived sessions footer reveal
entries.purpose: The archived-sessions reveal — a quiet footer row at the end of the sessions list (the rail head carries only SESSIONS/PROJECTS + NEW), shown only when ≥1 session is archived.
entries.promise: Clicking calls toggleArchived() and shows/hides archived session rows; label "▸ N archived" / "▾ hide archived".
entries.notes: REDESIGNED 2026-07-08: the #ws-archived head button was removed (Commander directive — rail head is SESSIONS/PROJECTS + NEW only); the reveal moved to a footer row inside #workstreams (updateArchivedToggle). Prior audit no longer applies — demoted to mapped, needs re-audit.
